rule_cards.title: 天干地支的五行与阴阳
rule_cards.statement: 甲乙属木、丙丁属火、戊己属土、庚辛属金、壬癸属水；寅卯属木、巳午属火、申酉属金、亥子属水、辰戌丑未属土。天干、地支按序奇数位为阳、偶数位为阴（甲丙戊庚壬、子寅辰午申戌为阳）。
rule_cards.cross_check: lunar-python 1.4.8 (MIT) LunarUtil.WU_XING_GAN / WU_XING_ZHI: all 22 entries agree.
rule_cards.review_status: Statement is this project's paraphrase. Cited at the level of the work; chapter-level citation and expert review are pending.

rule_cards.title: 五行生克
rule_cards.statement: 相生：木生火、火生土、土生金、金生水、水生木。相克：木克土、土克水、水克火、火克金、金克木。
rule_cards.cross_check: Used by R-SS-01, whose 100 outputs agree with lunar-python's Ten Gods table.
rule_cards.review_status: Statement is this project's paraphrase. Cited at the level of the work; chapter-level citation and expert review are pending.

rule_cards.title: 六十甲子与干支配对
rule_cards.statement: 天干与地支按序循环相配成六十甲子，只有阴阳相同的干支才能相配（如甲子、乙丑），甲丑、乙子之类的组合不存在。
rule_cards.cross_check: lunar-python 1.4.8 (MIT) LunarUtil.JIA_ZI: 60/60 pairs agree with conventions.CYCLE.
rule_cards.review_status: Statement is this project's paraphrase. Cited at the level of the work; chapter-level citation and expert review are pending.

rule_cards.title: 十神
rule_cards.statement: 以日干为“我”：同我者为比肩（阴阳同）、劫财（阴阳异）；我生者为食神（同）、伤官（异）；我克者为偏财（同）、正财（异）；克我者为七杀（同）、正官（异）；生我者为偏印（同）、正印（异）。
rule_cards.cross_check: lunar-python 1.4.8 (MIT) LunarUtil.SHI_SHEN: 100/100 day-stem and other-stem pairs agree.
rule_cards.review_status: Statement is this project's paraphrase. Cited at the level of the work; chapter-level citation and expert review are pending.

rule_cards.title: 地支藏干
rule_cards.statement: 子藏癸；丑藏己癸辛；寅藏甲丙戊；卯藏乙；辰藏戊乙癸；巳藏丙庚戊；午藏丁己；未藏己丁乙；申藏庚壬戊；酉藏辛；戌藏戊辛丁；亥藏壬甲。首位为本气。地支的十神按藏干分别论。
rule_cards.cross_check: lunar-python 1.4.8 (MIT) LunarUtil.ZHI_HIDE_GAN: 12/12 branches agree, including order.
rule_cards.review_status: Statement is this project's paraphrase. Cited at the level of the work; chapter-level citation and expert review are pending.

rule_cards.title: 天干五合与相冲
rule_cards.statement: 五合：甲己合（土）、乙庚合（金）、丙辛合（水）、丁壬合（木）、戊癸合（火）。相冲：甲庚、乙辛、丙壬、丁癸。

rule_cards.review_status: Statement is this project's paraphrase. Cited at the level of the work; chapter-level citation and expert review are pending.

rule_cards.title: 地支六合与六冲
rule_cards.statement: 六合：子丑、寅亥、卯戌、辰酉、巳申、午未。六冲：子午、丑未、寅申、卯酉、辰戌、巳亥。
rule_cards.cross_check: lunar-python 1.4.8 (MIT) LunarUtil.HE_ZHI_6 and CHONG: all pairs agree.
rule_cards.review_status: Statement is this project's paraphrase. Cited at the level of the work; chapter-level citation and expert review are pending.

rule_cards.title: 三合、半合与三会
rule_cards.statement: 三合局：申子辰合水、亥卯未合木、寅午戌合火、巳酉丑合金。三合局中含中间一支（子、卯、午、酉）的两支为半合。三会方：寅卯辰会木、巳午未会火、申酉戌会金、亥子丑会水。
rule_cards.cross_check: Standard table; no library table exists, so it is checked by unit tests of its own symmetry and coverage only.
rule_cards.review_status: Statement is this project's paraphrase. Cited at the level of the work; chapter-level citation and expert review are pending.

rule_cards.title: 刑、害、破
rule_cards.statement: 相刑：寅巳申三刑、丑戌未三刑、子卯相刑，辰午酉亥自刑。相害：子未、丑午、寅巳、卯辰、申亥、酉戌。相破：子酉、丑辰、寅亥、卯午、巳申、未戌。
rule_cards.cross_check: Standard table; checked by unit tests of its own symmetry and coverage only.
rule_cards.review_status: Statement is this project's paraphrase. Cited at the level of the work; chapter-level citation and expert review are pending.

rule_cards.title: 旬空
rule_cards.statement: 六十甲子每十个为一旬，每旬有两个地支轮空：甲子旬空戌亥、甲戌旬空申酉、甲申旬空午未、甲午旬空辰巳、甲辰旬空寅卯、甲寅旬空子丑。
rule_cards.review_status: Statement is this project's paraphrase. Cited at the level of the work; chapter-level citation and expert review are pending.

rule_cards.title: 旺相休囚死
rule_cards.statement: 以月支本气五行为当令：与月令同者旺，月令所生者相，生月令者休，克月令者囚，被月令所克者死。本项目把辰戌丑未月一律按土当令处理；也有流派按季节分配，结论可能不同。
rule_cards.cross_check: Declared convention; unit tests check that each month gives exactly one state per element.
rule_cards.review_status: Statement is this project's paraphrase. Cited at the level of the work; chapter-level citation and expert review are pending.

rule_cards.title: 十二长生
rule_cards.statement: 阳干顺行、阴干逆行：甲长生在亥、丙戊在寅、庚在巳、壬在申；乙长生在午、丁己在酉、辛在子、癸在卯。另有“阴阳同生同死”一说，本项目不采用。

rule_cards.review_status: Statement is this project's paraphrase. Cited at the level of the work; chapter-level citation and expert review are pending.

rule_cards.title: 月令取格（简化）
rule_cards.statement: 以月支本气相对日主的十神命名格局；本气为比肩称建禄格，为劫财时阳干称阳刃格、阴干称月劫格。古法还要看透干与会合，本项目只取本气，因此只是分类标签，不代表吉凶判断。
rule_cards.cross_check: Declared simplified convention; deterministic given R-CG-01 and R-SS-01.
rule_cards.review_status: Statement is this project's paraphrase. Cited at the level of the work; chapter-level citation and expert review are pending.

rule_cards.title: 日主强弱的三项计数
rule_cards.statement: 得令：日主五行在月令为旺或相。得地：四支藏干中有与日主同五行者。得势：年、月、时三干中至少两个为比劫或印。三项中占两项记为偏强，否则偏弱。各派权重不同，这只是计数约定，不是定论。
rule_cards.cross_check: Declared counting convention; deterministic given the tables above.
rule_cards.review_status: Statement is this project's paraphrase. Cited at the level of the work; chapter-level citation and expert review are pending.

rule_cards.title: 大运顺逆与排列
rule_cards.statement: 阳年生男、阴年生女，大运顺行；阴年生男、阳年生女，大运逆行。大运从月柱起，顺行取月柱之后的干支，逆行取之前的干支，每步十年。

rule_cards.review_status: Statement is this project's paraphrase. Cited at the level of the work; chapter-level citation and expert review are pending.

rule_cards.title: 起运岁数
rule_cards.statement: 顺行数到下一个节，逆行数到上一个节，三天折一年、一天折四个月、一个时辰折十天。起运时刻直接取 lunar-python 的结果（流派 1），不同软件的折算细则略有差别。
rule_cards.cross_check: Single source: lunar-python 1.4.8 (MIT) EightChar.getYun(gender, sect=1). Not independently verified.
rule_cards.review_status: Statement is this project's paraphrase. Cited at the level of the work; chapter-level citation and expert review are pending.

rule_cards.title: 流年干支
rule_cards.statement: 以立春为界，公历 Y 年立春后的年柱序数为 (Y − 4) mod 60（甲子为 0），例如 1984 年为甲子年。
rule_cards.cross_check: Same rule as the verified calendar engine's year pillar.
rule_cards.review_status: Statement is this project's paraphrase. Cited at the level of the work; chapter-level citation and expert review are pending.

rule_cards.title: 十神与六亲的传统对应
rule_cards.statement: 传统上以正印偏印为母亲与长辈，比肩劫财为兄弟姐妹，食神伤官为子女（女命）及才艺表达，正财偏财为财与父亲、男命以财为妻，正官七杀为事业约束、女命以官杀为夫、男命以官杀为子女。这是象征性的对应，不能据此断定任何人的实际经历。
rule_cards.cross_check: Traditional association only; not a verifiable fact about a person.
rule_cards.review_status: Statement is this project's paraphrase. Cited at the level of the work; chapter-level citation and expert review are pending.
